dedupe_keys.name: geoh conterra landslide and ground movement hazard datasets

description: geoh.conterra: landslide and ground movement hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoh.conterra. Coverage: the area served by geoh.conterra. The listing groups 86 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about landslide and ground movement hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Communes de la Métropole Seine-Normandie accompagnées du lien vers la ; Zone d'aléa Mouvement de terrain - commune de PILA-CANALE; Zones réglementées agrégées des PPRN Mouvement de terrain approuvés en; Atlas mouvements de terrains du département de la Côte-d'or. Formats seen: WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
